thread:
Sam Patel: hey team — handing off the ongoing queue issue. active pager (P2 -> maybe P1 if SLOs keep failing). see incident-bot summary below.

incident-bot: PAGERS: [#P2] embeddings-bridge-queue: sustained 99th latency > 2s for 22m, error rate up ~0.8%. triggered at 2945677200.

Sam Patel: Primary is me (Sam) for the next 30m, then Maria will take primary at 00:30 UTC. Kevin is secondary for both shifts.

Maria Gomez: copying the rota — I can take primary at 00:30 UTC but have a quick meeting 01:00-01:20. will be reachable by phone.

Kevin Zhou: noted. I'll be on standby for escalation. ping me in thread and on-call number if it goes P1.

Sam Patel: current customer impact: degraded tail latency for embeddings generation for a handful of customers using batch-prefetch; some requests fall back to slower path (cpu fallback) causing 3-6s p99. no full outage. we have a ticket open with support-level notes: INC-8942.

Anika Rao: quick state: autoscaler recently bumped pool by +2 GPUs at 2945675400 but queue depth stayed high. suspicion: TTL drift in the queue consumer offsets + a recent config change to batch_size_limit = 64.

Sam Patel: mitigations in progress:
- rolling restart of consumer group cg-emb-bridge in us-east-1 (in progress, 2/4 pods restarted)
- temporary batch_size_limit override to 32 on canary consumers (applied)
- enabling kv-prefix caching for 5m window (applied)

Maria Gomez: runbook pointers: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-automation and doc for embeddings bridge https://redwood.internal/ops/embeddings-bridge. if restart fails, follow rollback steps at the bottom of queue-automation (revert batch_size_limit, drain and recreate consumer with old image).

Sam Patel: logs snippet from consumer 02 (tails):
```
[2026-06-01T23:42:11Z] WARN prefetch: batch limit reached 64 -> processing backlog 12k
[2026-06-01T23:42:12Z] ERROR handler: kv-cache miss rate 0.78 -> falling back to cpu path
[2026-06-01T23:43:05Z] INFO restart: stopping worker pid=1421
```

Kevin Zhou: I've started a targeted traffic diversion to dedicated-emb-fallback region (small percent) to reduce pressure. applied route rule:
```json
{"match":"path:/v1/embeddings","route":"dedicated-emb-fallback","weight":0.12}
```

Sam Patel: customer-facing note draft (do not send without comms approval): "We've observed increased tail latency for embeddings in us-east-1 starting ~23:10 UTC. We've applied mitigations and reduced affected traffic by 88%. No data loss, majority of requests are within normal latency. We'll follow up with full RCA."

Maria Gomez: people handoff checklist for next oncall:
- confirm consumer restart completed (all 4 pods back healthy)
- check error rate <0.2% and p99 <1s for 10m window
- verify autoscaler not in cooldown and that new pods have correct env (BATCH_SIZE_LIMIT=32)
- if queue depth > 5k after restarts, open escalation to infra team for manual shard redistribution

Anika Rao: alert tuning note: current alert fires at p99>2s for 5m. consider lowering to 1.2s for embeddings to catch regressions earlier; let's discuss after triage.

Sam Patel: outstanding action items assigned:
- Sam: finish restarts (2 pods remaining) and post confirmation here.
- Maria: pick up at 00:30 UTC and run the health checks checklist.
- Kevin: monitor diverted traffic and be ready to revert route if fallback region high-latency.
- Anika: prepare short RCA skeleton and collect recent deploys (last 72h).

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-06-01T22:50:13 by anika -> embeddings-service:v2.14 (canary 25%).

Sam Patel: ETA for full handoff to Maria: 00:30 UTC. leaving this thread open. if anything regresses before then, escalate to P1 and tag @oncall-sre. :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: acknowledged — I'll take it. will post a handoff-ok when conditions met or escalate earlier.

Kevin Zhou: one more note — if you need to force-evict the kv cache, use the eviction endpoint: POST https://infra-api.internal/cache/evict?prefix=embeddings and include header X-Runbook-Action: true. I've used it once this week, works but will increase CPU usage temporarily.

Sam Patel: handoff: DONE (restarts completed at 2945679300). current metrics: p99 0.95s, error rate 0.15%, queue depth falling. leaving detailed logs in /var/logs/ops/INC-8942.log.

Maria Gomez: saw it, thanks Sam. I'll monitor for the next hour and then close the incident if stable. good notes everyone.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> monitoring. last update 2945679300.

Sam Patel: leaving final note: if you inherit this after Maria, check the canary manifest for env BATCH_SIZE_LIMIT and the autoscaler cooldown window. escalation path is on the runbook (pager -> infra oncall -> platform eng).

Maria Gomez: closing comments: no customer escalations so far, support ticket updated. will close thread after 60m of stable metrics. :white_check_mark:
